messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy complete: inference-api v2026.03.19-rc4 -> canary eu-west-1. Starting post-deploy synthetic probes now. Initial metrics show p95 lift on synth-kvprobe, rate of 503s increased. https://internal.metrics/redwood/xyz :rotating_light:
Sam: on it, saw the alert. grabbing layout of canary traffic.
Leah: is this limited to the canary pool or spreading to the pool host?
deploy-bot: Scope: canary eu-west-1 only. No infra CPU/GPU alarms. Error rate from synth-kvprobe 0.8% -> 3.4% over last 3m.
Omar: tagging oncall. @Kai FYI — can you check the inference-api pod logs and kv-warmup traces?
Kai: checking logs now. seeing a burst of `prefix_cache_miss` and repeated `KVFetchTimeout` around start-of-traffic. stack traces show retries queued up.
Sam: might be probes overloading the prefix-KV path during cold starts. We spike a lot of short concurrent probes.
Leah: decision options: 1) rollback, 2) throttle synthetic probes & stagger warmup, 3) pin canary to previous model variant. Thoughts?
Kai: not seeing model OOMs; looks like transient backpressure on kv fetch path. I prefer throttling probes first. Low-risk and fast.
Omar: agree with Kai. Also we should reduce probe concurrency to avoid cascading queues. Can we patch the probe controller?
Sam: propose: reduce probe rate to 30% for 10m, add jitter to start times, and rerun smoke after 5m. If p95 remains >2x baseline or error rate >2% -> consider roll-forward pin to v2026.03.18-stable.
Leah: looks good. I'm authorizing a 15m probe-rate change under the current change window.
Kai: patching probe controller now:
```bash
kubectl -n prod patch configmap/synth-probes --patch '{"data":{"rate":"0.3","jitter_ms":"400"}}'
kubectl rollout restart deployment/synth-probe-controller -n prod
```
Sam: also throttling synthetic traffic from the traffic-generator via feature-flag: `synth.throttle=0.3`
deploy-bot: Probe schedule updated. Current canary probe rate down to 30%. Monitoring back to 10s.
oncall-bot: Incident note: postdeploy probe anomaly observed (canary). Action: throttled synth probes; monitoring. Link: https://incidents/redwood/INC-2026-0319-01
Kai: after 6m: p95 trending back to baseline (1.1s -> 1.3s), error rate down to 0.9%. No additional spikes in queue depth.
Sam: running one more full quick-check (kvprobe + embed probe) in 2m.
Leah: if stable for 10m, we lift the temporary throttle and let normal cadence resume. No rollback for now.
deploy-bot: Quick-check passed. Post-deploy status: STABLE (observed window 12m). Reverting probe throttle in 5m. No pin/rollback required. :white_check_mark:
Omar: leaving a note for release notes: add post-deploy warmup note and recommend default stagger for synth probes on future canaries.
Sam: created ticket RETRO-304: "Probe backpressure mitigation: stagger + adaptive rate for warmup probes" and linked runbook snippet.
Leah: thanks team. closing thread unless anyone sees a regression. :thumbsup:
